name: Indiana Jones and the Emperor's Tomb

locations.note: 1935: in the jungles of British Ceylon Indy takes the idol of Kouru Watu from under the nose of the Nazi agent Von Beck.
Back at school in New York, Marshall Kai and Mei-Ying tell Indy of the Heart of the Dragon, the black pearl buried with China's first emperor.
Indy breaks into Prague Castle for the second piece of the Mirror of Dreams, past Gestapo agents and a superhuman test subject.
Captured and shipped to Istanbul, Indy escapes his cell and finds the Nazis digging into Belisarius's sunken city beneath it.
In British Hong Kong Indy and Mei-Ying start at the Golden Lotus Opera House and fight their way into Kai's fortress.
Disguised as a Nazi, Indy climbs Penglai Mountain to Kai's Black Dragon Fortress, where Mei-Ying is held.
The finale descends into the tomb of Qin Shi Huang, China's first emperor, for the Heart of the Dragon.

routes.name: The hunt for the Heart of the Dragon
routes.note: From the jungles of Ceylon and New York to Prague Castle, Istanbul and Hong Kong, then up Penglai Mountain and down into the first emperor's tomb.
